breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It explicitly defines two segments (Segment 1: x=0 to x=800mm with internal torque -50000 N·mm, and Segment 2: x=800mm to x=1200mm with internal torque 200000 N·mm), and computes stress and twist separately for each segment. This directly contradicts and corrects the incomplete prompt's instruction to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length,' aligning with the ground truth approach.
